description.en: Adds a Robots page to the sidebar. A robot is a directory the plugin creates under ~/.cache/dsh-plugin-robots/robots and mounts as a DSH workspace; only robots created here are managed. For each robot you can install project-level skills through npx skills, edit its AGENTS.md, open its conversation, or re-mount it after the workspace was removed. Every robot also has a preset avatar (assigned on creation, changeable from the page), and the plugin exposes the ctx.bukaRobots service (list robots, avatar lookup, a blocking startSession plus non-blocking dispatchSession / openSession with an observable handle; every robot session always submits a structured JSON result through the scoped structured_output tool, optionally constrained by outputSchema and, for workflow nodes, the outgoing route names, with bounded result retries and an optional abortable escape for workflow nodes; sessions are normal runtime-root conversations under the normal approval policy, so they can request tool approvals or ask the user questions, and can be continued by session id with its history compacted first; after a turn releases its live agent the still-persisted session is re-announced to clients (api-session/added), so it does not vanish from the sidebar and the run page can still open it) for other plugins such as Buka Workflows. Installing the plugin also adds the robot-builder mode: new sessions can pick 机器人构建, which asks what the robot should do, drafts its AGENTS.md, then creates and mounts the robot with the preset-only buka_robot_build tool; creating, editing and skill installation on the page keep working. A general-purpose robot sits at the top of the list: fixed 🤖 avatar, standard mode, enters any existing workspace; the page's Settings dialog enables or disables it (persisted in settings.json). Every robot also carries a one-sentence responsibility statement (like a skill description): the read-only buka_robots tool returns it so workflows can choose the robot. While enabled, the general-purpose robot also appears at the end of the workflow robot list with the same fields as any other robot; disabling it removes it from that list. Every robot can be renamed: its directory is moved to the new name, its registry entry is updated and its DSH workspace is re-registered at the new path, and earlier conversations are kept in history but no longer listed under the robot.
description.zh-cn: 在侧边栏新增「机器人」页面。机器人是本插件在 ~/.cache/dsh-plugin-robots/robots 下创建并挂载成 DSH 工作区的目录，只有这里创建的机器人才归插件管理。每个机器人可以用 npx skills 安装项目级 skills、编辑自己的 AGENTS.md、一键打开会话；工作区被删掉后还能重新挂载。每个机器人还带一个预设头像（新建时自动分配，详情页可更换），并通过 ctx.bukaRobots 服务向其他插件（例如 Buka Workflows）开放 list()、avatarMap()、阻塞的 startSession() 与非阻塞的 dispatchSession() / openSession()（后者返回可观测句柄）；每个机器人会话都必须交回一个 JSON 结果（scoped 工具 structured_output，可传 outputSchema 与工作流出边名约束，错了有次数上限的追问，工作流节点可传 abortable 允许用 abort 主动终止）；会话是运行时根会话、走正常审批策略，可以在会话里请求工具审批或向用户提问，也能按 sessionId 续接（续接前先 compact 历史）。释放 live agent 后会把仍持久化的会话补通告回客户端（api-session/added），所以它不会从侧边栏消失，运行页「打开会话」也照常可用。安装插件还会多出一个「机器人构建」模式：新建会话时可选，它先问清机器人要做什么，起草 AGENTS.md，再用只对该模式可见的 buka_robot_build 工具创建并挂载机器人；页面上的新建、编辑 AGENTS.md 与安装 skills 照常可用。列表顶部还有一个通用型机器人：固定 🤖 头像、标准模式、可进入任意已有工作区；页面「设置」对话框里的开关决定它是否显示（开关存 settings.json）。每个机器人还带一句职责（对应 description 字段，类似 skill 的 description）：只读工具 buka_robots 会把它返回给编排器，工作流据此选择机器人。通用型机器人启用时也会出现在工作流机器人清单的最后，字段与普通机器人相同；停用后不再出现。每个机器人都可以重命名：机器人目录会一并改名，登记表条目就地更新、DSH 工作区按新路径重建，已有会话日志保留但不再列在这个机器人下。
